summary: Task 10 implementation reviewed inline. Code follows existing project patterns (per-row try/except, sanitize_error_message on all error strings, module-level helpers next to _fallback_publish). No HIGH or CRITICAL findings.

findings.finding: When _fallback_publish succeeds we call send_telegraph_teaser (side-effect inside the helper) — confirmed intentional per Decision 13 (overflow reuses same helper). No action needed.

On overflow-pass exception we set accepted=[] — this is defensive but could starve the queue for a tick if the overflow helper crashes mid-flight. Acceptable trade-off: cap protection > lost tick. Log trail gives admin visibility.

On move_to_failed (3-strike) path we increment evicted_count — this is semantically 'slot freed' not 'auto-published'. Admin-ping wording says 'auto-published {E}' which conflates the two. Deliberate per task-file: a 3-strike failure IS a slot free.

retry_from_failed returning False is surfaced with exit 1 and stderr — task file says 'exit 0 on success, 1 if N out of range' (does not explicitly cover the defensive-False path). Current behaviour is safer for the operator (clear signal that nothing happened).
